headline: Marketing Operations | Technology & Automation | Analytics
headline_rationale: Atlas emphasizes marketing infrastructure, technology integrations, website operations, measurement and cross-functional leadership. The master directly supports ERP/information architecture, CRM implementation, reporting automation, website/GraphQL automation and team leadership. The headline positions that supported work without inventing global enterprise governance ownership or SaaS tenure.
summary: Marketing operations leader who connects technology, data and cross-functional execution. Modernized systems and reporting for a B2B distributor, integrated CRM and ERP workflows, and built automated reporting across more than ten marketing channels using Python, SQL, Databricks and Funnel.io. Experience includes leading an eight-person team, developing KPI and investment forecasts with senior management, and automating commerce workflows through APIs and GraphQL. Brings hands-on implementation experience alongside budget, measurement and organizational-change work.
factual_review: Read the current v4 Word master directly, including Any Hour Services CRM/Go High Level, Power BI, ERP/API implementation, team training and MCC operating-system passages. Summary is also directly supported by E001, E005, E008, E009, E010, E038, E063, E066, E072, E081, E093 and E096. The job asks for global SaaS/enterprise governance; no unsupported claim to those specifics or fixed marketing-operations tenure is added.
